limitations: Positive distinct slopes, real affine offsets and Hilbert Paley–Wiener spaces only; arbitrary-offset norms outside the phase-alignment case and nonreal offsets are not classified. Implicit prior representation-theoretic coverage remains a bibliographic risk.
scientific_integrity: The full offset-uniform result is proved using Fourier support, Mellin packets and Kronecker phase relations. Numerical finite-window tests are ancillary, not certificates of the universal result.
title: Offset-uniform norm additivity for finite affine Paley–Wiener composition sums
